title: About 29% of small employer firms report complying with government regulations as an operational challenge

history.reason: Signal from Federal Reserve Small Business Credit Survey; nature of the compliance burden unspecified.

description: In the 2024 Small Business Credit Survey, 29 percent of small employer firms cited complying with government regulations as an operational challenge, up from 25 percent in 2023.
customer_segment: US small employer firms with 1-499 employees; no breakdown by regulation or industry recorded.
context: A broad signal. It does not identify which regulations, how much time or money, or which firms.

evidence.text: 29 percent of firms in the 2024 survey (N=7,545) reported complying with government regulations as an operational challenge, versus 25 percent in 2023.
Compliance ranked below reaching customers (57%) and hiring (51%) as an operational challenge in 2024.

contradictory_evidence.text: Compliance is a minority concern relative to growth and hiring, and the survey is a convenience sample.

uncertainty: Unknown: which regulations, cost, who is most affected, and willingness to pay. Pair with specific-regulation records to find concrete problems.
open_questions: Which regulations drive the reported challenge, by industry and firm size?
next_actions: Look for survey or SBA data breaking compliance burden down by regulation.
